_: Assertions about tokens.css that a regex can't infer and a person forgets. Read by scripts/check.mjs and, later, by the ladder story — one file so the linter and the picture can't disagree.

themeInvariant._: Tokens deliberately declared in one theme only. Everything else must exist in both, or dark silently resolves to nothing.

lightOnly.--toast-accent: The toast surface is dark under both themes, so its accent is tuned for dark and must not flip.
lightOnly.--radius-sm: A corner radius has no theme.
lightOnly.--radius-md: A corner radius has no theme.
lightOnly.--radius-lg: A corner radius has no theme.

darkOnly.--tb-fill: Glass controls exist only in dark; light draws the same chip with a shadow and no rim.

ladders.why: Every neutral fill is one gray at a different alpha, so the system reduces to an ordering. Break it and a hovered control reads heavier than the selected one — a real bug found twice in the audit, both times using entirely correct tokens.
The white family. Dark mixes a white and a gray family, and only same-base tokens are comparable.

equals.why: A hovered button and a selected one read alike on purpose. Breaking it silently changes what 'engaged' means.
